text:
ana: Heads up — we're targeting a base-image cutover next Tue 03:00 UTC. Two moving parts: rotate the cosign signing key in KMS and tighten the image-pull service-account RBAC. Need quick sanity check on audit logging, rollout strategy, and runtime fallout (KV cache / pinned containers).

siva: Which clusters/namespaces are in scope? full fleet or just prod/staging? Also: do we plan node drains or rolling pod restarts?

ana (correction)

ana: sorry typo — ana above. Plan is: prod + canary cluster (5% nodes) first. We'll do staged namespace lists in the PR. Expect service-account RBAC change to remove cluster-wide secret reads.

marta: For KMS/cosign rotation: we must publish a migration window and dual-sign artifacts for one day. Signing gateway needs a hotswap path. Also set an explicit audit marker for key-rotation events so SRE/SEC can filter them. Recommend retention >= 180d for registry/audit logs during migration.

jordan: Runtime notes: tightening image-pull SA can break older nodes that rely on node-level imagePullSecrets. If you're removing clusterrole verbs, ensure nodes still have access via projected tokens or node-level secrets. When restarting pods, watch for ephemeral-credentialed workloads — they may fail on restart.

ana: Example quick commands we'll use during canary:

```
# cordon + drain one canary node
kubectl cordon node-canary-1
kubectl drain node-canary-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# restart image-puller daemonset to force re-pull
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/image-puller -n infra
# verify signatures for a sample image
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/prod/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/app@sha256:... 
```

marta: Add post-cutover checks:
- cosign verify on a sample of images across registries
- registry audit: key-rotation marker present and signer alias change logged
- SBOM/attestation chain intact

sec-bot: [automated] Detected planned KMS alias change scheduled for 2026-03-23T03:00Z. Open PR required for signer-role updates.

siva: I'll take oncall ownership for the window. Quick rollback knobs:
- revert signer alias to previous KMS key (we keep it active for 24h)
- rollback RBAC changes via CI (flag-controlled)
- re-tag images to previous signed tag if verification rejects

jordan: I'll add the following dashboards/alerts before the window: image_pull_failures (1m), runtime_authz_denials (5m), node_restart_rate (10m). Also add a short-runbook snippet that checks `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=Failed` and greps for image pull errors.

marta: Also prepare an incident template: triage -> verify cosign sig -> check KMS key state -> check registry audit -> escalate to infra if node-level secret issue. Add sample `cosign verify` and `gcloud kms keys versions list` commands in the template.

ana: Perfect. I'll open a PR with the step-by-step rollout and include the canary schedule, audit retention request, and links to the runbooks. Tagging @siva @marta @jordan for review. :thumbsup:

siva: ack, will review this afternoon.

marta: leaving a note — run a dry-run of signature verification tooling against staging images before rotation. Found subtle manifest format issues once.

ana: will do. thanks everyone.
